currentGoal: Investigate and reduce choppy/laggy gameplay when the field gets very large.
workCompleted: Profiled before optimizing with desktop 1200/2500 perf harnesses, live 2500 stress sampling, and mobile 2500 harness.
Added allocation-light regrowing tile sampling helpers in FieldSystem: getRandomRegrowingTile and sampleRegrowingTiles.
Swapped sprinkler growth targeting and earthworm companion burrow targeting away from building/filtering/shuffling full regrowing tile arrays.
Replaced pickGrassTier's temporary weighted array allocation with a direct weighted roll that preserves the same integer weight distribution.
Added large-field ambient feedback budget scaling so helper bursts, transient objects, pop texts, reward arcs, and world-action arcs are capped more aggressively at 1200+ and 2000+ tiles.
Deferred automation-generated trigger-feed rendering to the regular UI cadence instead of force-rendering inside automation scheduler ticks.
Kept board layout, render texture sizing, save behavior, automation economics, and gameplay formulas unchanged apart from equivalent random sampling implementation details.

profilingNotes: Initial 2500 live stress showed periodic helper spikes: sprinkler around 13 ms and companions around 6 ms in hot summaries.
Regrow idle cost grew with field size because many regrown patches called pickGrassTier; direct weighted rolling reduced allocation pressure.
Final 2500 live stress still shows occasional UI trigger-feed hotspots, but frame spikes stayed at 0 and maxFrameDeltaMs stayed below the 34 ms spike threshold.
Desktop 2500 harness can show nearly every tile as visible when the board is fitted on a large viewport; mobile harness correctly culled to about 49 visible tiles.
knownIssuesAndRisks: The remaining live-stress hotspots are mostly UI trigger-feed refresh and occasional helper visual work, not board layout or render texture resizing.
Ambient effects are intentionally less dense on very large fields. If the field feels too quiet visually at 2000+ tiles, tune LARGE_FIELD_AMBIENT_BUDGET_SCALE and HUGE_FIELD_AMBIENT_BUDGET_SCALE.

sampleRegrowingTiles uses reservoir sampling over the regrowing key set. It avoids array allocation/shuffle bursts but still iterates regrowing keys when a helper specifically asks for random regrowing tiles.
No balance changes were made to automation rates, rewards, quest rewards, or grass-tier weights.
